name: Double-uncrowded calm momentum — low funding x low vol gate (long spot)
rationale: CROSS-METRIC (funding_rate x vol_realized) two-gate momentum — distinct from the single-gate funding-gated-momentum (funding ceiling only) by requiring BOTH an UNCROWDED leverage state AND a CALM volatility regime simultaneously. The economic claim: momentum's favorable-skew premium is maximized precisely when the trade is NOT crowded (funding below a ceiling = leverage hasn't piled in, so there is room to run) AND vol is contained (calm = no whipsaw/crash). Either gate alone leaves a failure mode open: low-funding-but-turbulent (the move runs but gets stopped by noise) or calm-but-crowded (low vol masking a crowded top). Requiring both prunes both failure modes — orthogonal confirmations of 'momentum's friendly weather'. Mechanism before data: long spot when ret is positive AND funding is below a fitted ceiling AND realized vol is below a fitted ceiling; exit when momentum flips. Distinct from funding-gated-momentum (funding only), vol-regime-gated-momentum (vol only), and xsec-momentum-funding-gated (adds funding+vol but on a CROSS-SECTIONAL rank primary; this is a per-instrument time-series momentum with the double gate). Disconfirmer 1: drop EITHER gate — if a single-gate version matches the deflated Sharpe, the second gate is redundant and this duplicates an existing single-gate spec. Disconfirmer 2: both gates may co-fire so often the joint state is just 'calm bull market' = a long-bias proxy; a plain spot long over the same sample/costs must not match. Disconfirmer 3 (PIT/cost): net of ~20bps the gated momentum must clear. tier0 funding_rate + tier0 vol_realized/ret, fresh prod data, unproven combination — low-confidence until OOS.
catalyst: positive momentum WHILE funding is uncrowded AND realized vol is calm — a double-confirmed friendly-weather trend, long spot
